nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "Why did the guard drop us?"
nodes.text_zh: "为什么警卫把我们放下来了?"

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "I'll tell you why," said Bajie.
nodes.text_zh: "我告诉你原因吧,"八戒说道。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "He's a villain! He thinks it's funny to drop people!"
nodes.text_zh: "他是个反派!他觉得欺负别人很有趣!"

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: The pig waved his fist at the guard, who was now far away. "Villain!"

vocab.phrase_zh: 悟空缓缓转过身来,面向唐僧。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text_en: "I think I know why he dropped us, Master. You must face one hundred challenges in order to become a buddha. You probably got to the Western Paradise before you'd faced all of them."
nodes.text_zh: "我想我知道他为何抛弃我们了,大师。你必须克服一百道考验才能成佛;或许你在尚未经历所有这些考验之前,就已经抵达了西方极乐世界。"

vocab.phrase_en: You must face one hundred challenges in order to become a buddha.
